_doc: Original texture id (blockout material slot) -> real material asset. Slots not listed use the generated placeholder MI_<grd> (tools/textures/make_placeholders.py). Zone-art slots named <grd>__<variant> use <grd>'s material with the parameters of `variants`. See docs/adr/0003-environment-art-pipeline.md.

variants._doc: Material parameter overrides for <grd>__<variant> slots (written by tools/blender/build_zone_art.py).

displacement._doc: Nanite displacement strength (0..1, full range +-2.5 cm) for zone-art (Nanite) meshes using these textures; unlisted textures don't displace. Heights come from T_<grd>_H (make_placeholders.py).

ground._doc: Floors drawn with the world-aligned ground master instead of the blockout UVs: the original texture at two scales blended by macro noise (breaks up tiling), tinted by the macro noise. tile_m = the original repeat size (floors tile once per 2.2 m grid square in the original client, whatever the texture's size).

grass._doc: Grass tuft colours (sRGB), sampled from the original grass texture (grd02306): its middle fifth at the root, a little above its lightest fifth at the tip.
